verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed that a single skill (skill-creator) can be installed from the anthropics/skills collection with `npx skills add --skill`, but that is third-party tooling. The first-party Claude Code path installs plugins "as one unit": the repo marketplace offers grouped bundles (document-skills, example-skills), and disableBundledSkills is all-or-nothing. The API does let you pick individual skills by skill_id per request (up to 20). Missing for 10: first-party per-skill install from the Claude Code marketplace, documented granular selection within a plugin bundle, and selective disabling of individual bundled skills.
